items.text: Bed type confirmed: stock MDF (15.0 mm), M5 low-head bed screws
Right-column bed screw positions verified (23.5 / 10.5 / 104.25 / 185.0 mm)
Check whether the AD5M nozzle is hardened steel (PETG-CF needs it)
Measure your circular magnets (cover needs 3 × 10 × 2 mm)
Run `version` and `model` in MDI; record the number after CA1 (needed to revert)
Check for a spare DRV8825 or 4th-axis driver
Order the geared stepper 17HS15-1584S-MG50 (critical path)
Order the M12 24 V NPN laser sensor
Amazon.ca basket: DRV8825, springs, JST-SM kit, M3 inserts, roller switch, PC817
Call an Ottawa distributor for Gates 425-5M-09 (or order online)
Hardware store: M5×30 low-head ×3, M6 nuts ×2, M6×16, M6×20 ×2, M3 countersunk ×16, M4×10/12, 4 mm pin, CA glue
Machinable stock: 12 mm HDPE board, 4–6 mm 6061 offcut
Run ./scripts/fetch_upstream.sh (upstream STEP files)
Print bore_test_coupons and pick the hole compensation for 14.06 and 8.1 bores
Print atc_bed_adapter (PETG, 6 walls, 50 %)
Print TopGear_v2 and BottomGear (6 walls, 100 % infill)
Print MotorMount (supports on build plate only) and ATCSensorMount
Print magazine body + 8 pods (16 parts)
Print SensorMount, Cover halves, chip caps ×2, signal box + lid
Press 8 × M3 heat inserts into MotorMount
Drill microswitch holes to 3 mm; wire COM + NC; crimp 2-pin JST-SM
Build the PC817 interface board and bench-test it with 24 V
Check motor coil pairs; crimp the motor connector
Load 24 springs and pods; every pod springs back freely
Face the magazine bottom flat on the Carvera
Press 2 × M6 nuts into the adapter pockets
(Optional) TB6600 + Pico bench test of motor and belt
Swap the manual lever for BottomGear (cam top-right, M6×20)
Key + TopGear on the motor; motor on mount (4 × M4×12)
Remove the spindle top cover; pull out the ATC motor and ATC sensor cables
Fit the belt and tension the mount with the 4 × M3 cover screws
Mount the switch bracket (2 × M4×10), lowest position
Fit the DRV8825 in the spare socket; set VRef ≈ 0.55 V
Fit the adapter: 4 mm pin at (142, −15), 3 × M5×30 low-head
Bolt the magazine down: M6×16 back, M6×20 front; fit chip caps
Mount the laser sensor; wire through the opto to EXT yellow (0.21)
Install Community Firmware + Controller (≥ 2.1.0c-RC1)
Run `model` and record the number after CA1
Paste all setup commands (safe-Z already raised for this machine)
Copy custom_tool_slots.txt to the SD card root and reboot
Power-on: no alarm; long-press clamps and unclamps; no skipped steps
Switch bracket trips exactly at end of unclamp; unplugged switch alarms
Laser ignores the lid, sees a tool; input 0.21 polarity right
Teach T1 (back) and T8 (front); check the 20.00 mm pitch
Dry runs: T1→T8→T1 ×10, no spindle rotation
Missing-tool test: sensor stops the change
50 consecutive changes at full speed, zero faults
Real 3-tool job completes
Mill a permanent adapter from 12 mm HDPE or 6061
Mill the TopGear keyway inlay from 4 mm 6061
Trial: machined magazine body (Phase 2 candidate)
Log hours, costs, reprints and annoyances in the Log tab
